From origin to your cup

The bean-to-cup journey.

Origin
Harvest
Process
Roast

Your Cup
01 / 06

Born in the highlands.

Every extraordinary coffee begins in volcanic soil, high altitude, and equatorial sun. Voltresso connects you to the origin of every bean: 50+ countries, hundreds of varieties.

02 / 06

Picked at peak.

Only perfectly ripe cherries produce exceptional coffee. Voltresso teaches you how harvest method (hand-picked, strip or selective) shapes the cup.

03 / 06

Processed with intent.

Washed, natural, honey, anaerobic: each method unlocks a different flavour dimension. Our bean library shows exactly what each one does.

04 / 06

Roasted to profile.

Light, medium, dark: each roast demands different brew parameters. Voltresso adjusts every guide automatically, based on the roast you're brewing.

05 / 06

Dialled in.

Grind is the single most powerful variable in coffee. Voltresso's calibration assistant walks you through finding the exact setting for every new bag.

06 / 06

Your perfect shot.

Log it, rate it, refine it. Over time, your brew history tells the story of you becoming a measurably better barista.

Questions

Frequently asked.

What is Voltresso?

A coffee brewing companion: machine-aware brew guides, a shot logger with scores, Volt for one clear fix per shot, a bean and recipe library, a coffee passport and a map of specialty cafés near you.

Who built Voltresso?

A passionate barista who loves every kind of coffee: espresso, Turkish, pour-over, Moka. Years of pulling shots, reading and brewing every single day went into it, with one goal: make great coffee easier for everyone.

Which machines are supported?

140+ machines across single boiler, dual boiler, heat exchanger, lever and more, and the list keeps growing. Can’t find yours? Submit it in the app.

How does Volt work?

Volt is built into the app and knows your machine, beans and shot history. Free users get daily answers; Pro unlocks unlimited, deeper conversations.

Is it free?

The full brewing loop is free forever. Pro unlocks unlimited Volt, advanced tools without the XP wait, shot comparisons and premium recaps. Founding members can lock in Pro for life. No ads, ever.

Does it work without internet?

Most of Voltresso works offline: guides, recipes, the bean library and shot logging. Bag scanning, the café map and Volt Pro need a connection.

I own a café. How do I join?

Claiming your listing is free. Café Pro adds custom loyalty rules, insights and map features. The first 20 cafés in Belgrade get Café Pro free for 3 months in our pilot. Email us to apply.

Will it connect to my smart machine?

We’re exploring it for a future release. We’d love to deliver it, and we want to get it right.

When is Voltresso launching?

Soon. Follow us on Instagram or Facebook for the announcement.
